name: CI
on: push: branches: [ 'main', 'develop' ] pull_request: branches: [ 'main', 'develop' ] workflow_dispatch: inputs: testTag: description: 'Tag de Karate a ejecutar (puede incluir o no @). Si se deja vacío en ejecución manual, se usará @smoketest en integración.' required: false default: ''
jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest env: JAVA_VERSION: '21' steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }} uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: 'temurin' java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
- name: Cache Gradle uses: actions/cache@v4 with: path: | ~/.gradle/caches ~/.gradle/wrapper key: gradle-${{ runner.os }}-jdk-${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}-${{ hashFiles('**/build.gradle','**/settings.gradle','**/gradle.lockfile') }} restore-keys: | gradle-${{ runner.os }}-jdk-${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}-
- name: Make gradlew executable run: chmod +x ./gradlew
- name: Run tests (with tag support) run: | # Determine tag: use workflow_dispatch input when present, otherwise default to @smoketest for CI events if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then tag='${{ github.event.inputs.testTag }}' else tag='@smoketest' fi
# normalize: if tag is not empty and doesn't start with @, prepend it if [ -n "$tag" ] && [ "${tag#@}" = "$tag" ]; then tag="@$tag" fi
echo "Using Karate tag: '$tag'"
if [ -n "$tag" ]; then ./gradlew clean test --no-daemon --console=plain --stacktrace -Dkarate.options="--tags $tag" else ./gradlew clean test --no-daemon --console=plain --stacktrace fi
- name: List target output (for debugging) if: always() run: | echo "-- target dir listing --" ls -la target || true echo "-- karate reports listing --" ls -la target/karate-reports || true echo "-- test results listing --" ls -la target/test-results || true
- name: Upload Karate reports if: always() uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: karate-reports path: target/karate-reports
- name: Upload test results if: always() uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: test-results path: target/test-results

name: CI
on: push: branches: [ '**' ] pull_request: branches: [ '**' ] workflow_dispatch: inputs: karateOptions: description: 'Valor para -Dkarate.options (ejemplo: classpath:features/onOff.feature o --tags @smoketest classpath:features/onOff.feature).' required: false default: 'classpath:features/onOff.feature'
jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest env: JAVA_VERSION: '21' steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }} uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: 'temurin' java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
- name: Cache Gradle uses: actions/cache@v4 with: path: | ~/.gradle/caches ~/.gradle/wrapper key: gradle-${{ runner.os }}-jdk-${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}-${{ hashFiles('**/build.gradle','**/settings.gradle','**/gradle.lockfile') }} restore-keys: | gradle-${{ runner.os }}-jdk-${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}-
- name: Make gradlew executable run: chmod +x ./gradlew
- name: Run Karate tests run: | # Use manual input when workflow_dispatch is used; otherwise run onOff automatically. if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then karate_opts='${{ github.event.inputs.karateOptions }}' else karate_opts='classpath:features/onOff.feature' fi
# Fallback in case manual input is empty. if [ -z "$karate_opts" ]; then karate_opts='classpath:features/onOff.feature' fi
echo "Using karate.options: '$karate_opts'" ./gradlew clean test --no-daemon --console=plain --stacktrace -Dkarate.options="$karate_opts"
- name: List target output (for debugging) if: always() run: | echo "-- target dir listing --" ls -la target || true echo "-- karate reports listing --" ls -la target/karate-reports || true echo "-- test results listing --" ls -la target/test-results || true
- name: Upload Karate reports if: always() uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: karate-reports path: target/karate-reports
- name: Upload test results if: always() uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: test-results path: target/test-results
